properties.description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.\r\n
properties.short_description: Transform forgotten meadows into charming dioramas filled with whimsical structures and procedural details, without management or combat.

short_descriptions.value: Verwandle vergessene Wiesen in charmante Dioramen mit verspielten Strukturen und prozeduralen Details, ohne Management oder Kampf.
Transforma praderas olvidadas en encantadores dioramas con estructuras caprichosas y detalles generados proceduralmente, sin gestión ni combate.
Transformez des prairies oubliées en dioramas charmants avec des structures fantaisistes et des détails procéduraux, sans gestion ni combat.
Transform forgotten meadows into charming dioramas filled with whimsical structures and procedural details, without management or combat.

properties.description: Embark on an exciting space adventure where you take control of a spaceship and battle endless waves of enemies across the galaxy. Collect coins as you blast through your foes and unlock new, powerful ships to enhance your journey. With every wave, the challenge intensifies—how long can you survive the cosmic chaos? Prepare to gear up and zap your way to victory!
properties.short_description: Control a spaceship to battle waves of enemies, collect coins, and unlock powerful ships in a cosmic adventure.

short_descriptions.value: Steuere ein Raumschiff, kämpfe gegen Wellen von Feinden, sammle Münzen und schalte mächtige Schiffe in einem kosmischen Abenteuer frei.
Controla una nave espacial para combatir oleadas de enemigos, recoger monedas y desbloquear naves poderosas en una aventura cósmica.
Contrôlez un vaisseau spatial pour combattre des vagues d'ennemis, collecter des pièces et débloquer des vaisseaux puissants dans une aventure cosmique.
Control a spaceship to battle waves of enemies, collect coins, and unlock powerful ships in a cosmic adventure.

properties.description: \"Tiny Hero Idle\": An Idle RPG on PC that allows simultaneous play with other games. Join a unique adventure with daily rewards and cool actions\r\n
properties.short_description: Players embark on a unique adventure in an idle RPG, earning daily rewards while engaging in simultaneous gameplay with other titles.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler begeben sich auf ein einzigartiges Abenteuer in einem Idle-RPG, verdienen tägliche Belohnungen und spielen gleichzeitig mit anderen Titeln.
Los jugadores emprenden una aventura única en un RPG idle, ganando recompensas diarias mientras juegan simultáneamente con otros títulos.
Les joueurs se lancent dans une aventure unique dans un RPG idle, gagnant des récompenses quotidiennes tout en jouant simultanément avec d'autres titres.
Players embark on a unique adventure in an idle RPG, earning daily rewards while engaging in simultaneous gameplay with other titles.

properties.description:
Welcome to TEENY TINY TOWN, where you can indulge your inner city planner and craft your very own bustling city! Merge, build, and watch your town flourish before your eyes. Teeny Tiny Town offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying merging experience.

In this captivating puzzle game, your objective is to combine three or more items on the board to construct new structures. Start with humble trees and transform them into majestic houses, and then merge those houses to create even grander residences! Unleash your creativity and witness your town grow exponentially.

As your city thrives, collect gold from your houses to unlock and acquire new items, expanding your options for development. Strategically manage your resources to maximize your town's potential.

Challenge your puzzle-solving skills across multiple levels, each presenting unique obstacles and opportunities. Discover new strategies, overcome hurdles, and master the art of efficient urban planning.

Key Features:
- Easy-to-play & relaxing gameplay
- Engaging levels with diverse challenges to keep you captivated.
- Square and hexagon maps
- Expand your city by merging items and unlock a vast array of structures.
- Compete on global leaderboards
- Achievements
- Relaxing music and ambient sounds

The game supports the following languages: French, Hindi, German, Spanish, Russian, Swedish, Italian, Japanese, Thai, Korean, Portuguese.

Unleash your inner architect and experience the joy of building your own TEENY TINY TOWN! How expansive can you make it before the board reaches its limits?
properties.short_description: Create and expand your own city by merging items and solving puzzles in a charming urban planning adventure.

short_descriptions.value: Erstelle und erweitere deine eigene Stadt, indem du Gegenstände kombinierst und Rätsel in einem charmanten Städtebau-Abenteuer löst.
Crea y expande tu propia ciudad fusionando objetos y resolviendo acertijos en una encantadora aventura de planificación urbana.
Créez et développez votre propre ville en fusionnant des objets et en résolvant des énigmes dans une charmante aventure d'urbanisme.
Create and expand your own city by merging items and solving puzzles in a charming urban planning adventure.

properties.description:
Terry wants to launch himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town. 

Step into Terry’s flip flops in this short and delightfully sweet adventure of self-discovery as he uncovers what it means to be an inhabitant of Sprankelwater.

Run, drive and glide through this small journey of big discoveries as Terry works towards achieving this goal.
properties.short_description: A young adventurer embarks on a whimsical journey to launch himself into space, discovering the meaning of home along the way.

short_descriptions.value: Ein junger Abenteurer begibt sich auf eine wunderliche Reise ins All und entdeckt dabei die Bedeutung von Heimat.
Un joven aventurero emprende un viaje fantástico para lanzarse al espacio, descubriendo el significado del hogar en el camino.
Un jeune aventurier se lance dans un voyage fantaisiste pour s'envoyer dans l'espace, découvrant le sens du foyer en chemin.
A young adventurer embarks on a whimsical journey to launch himself into space, discovering the meaning of home along the way.
